question: My opponent's Serra Angel is enchanted with Frogify. I cast Clone and copy the Serra Angel. What does my Clone look like?

expected.shortAnswer: A normal Serra Angel with flying and vigilance, not a Frog: a copy takes only copiable values.
expected.answer: Your Clone is a Serra Angel: a white Angel with flying and vigilance and Serra Angel's printed power and toughness, not a 1/1 blue Frog. A copy effect takes only the copiable values of the original — what is printed on the card, as modified by other copy effects (707.2) — and copy effects apply in layer 1 (613.1a). Frogify's effect is not a copy effect and applies only to the creature it enchants, so your Clone doesn't get it.

whyHard: A copy takes only copiable values (layer 1), so an effect that changed the original afterwards, such as an Aura, is not copied.
